# jumpcloud_approval_flow (Data Source)

Use this data source to read a JumpCloud approval flow.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jumpcloud_approval_flow" "example" {
  name = "Request Production Access"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the approval flow.

### Read-Only

- `approval_type` (String) The approval type.
- `description` (String) The description of the approval flow.
- `name` (String) The name of the approval flow.
- `non_admin_approval` (Boolean) Whether non-admins can approve.
- `resource_id` (String) The resource ID this flow grants access to.
- `resource_type` (String) The resource type.
- `status` (String) Status of the approval flow.
- `time_based_access` (Boolean) Whether access is time-limited.
